title: Stochastic burstload harness and regression detector for multi-GPU inference
creator: Ava Patel
description:
Problem: We need a reproducible, production-oriented harness to stress and detect regressions in multi-GPU distributed inference (TP/PP) jobs. Existing suites focus on steady-state saturations; they underrepresent short bursts, stochastic concurrency, and KV-cache warmup effects that commonly trigger p95 regressions in the field.

Goal: Build a stochastic burstload generator + automated regression detector that: (1) simulates realistic bursty traffic and controlled noise injection, (2) runs across TP/PP mesh shapes and heterogeneous GPU mixes, (3) measures tokens/sec and tail latency (p95/p99) with warmup-aware windows, and (4) flags regressions with operationally low false-positive rates while providing root-cause hints (KV warmup, imbalance, kernel selection changes).

Why this matters: Customers hit intermittent p95 spikes during microbursts and cold KV-cache scenarios. Those regressions are high-impact for SLAs and hard to reproduce in current nightly runs. This harness should reduce time-to-detect, improve triage signal, and enable safe rollbacks/fallbacks in rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic burst generator can reproduce 3 canonical patterns (microburst, sawtooth, Poisson bursts) with configurable amplitude, duration, and inter-arrival statistics
Harness runs on CI/infra against TP/PP topologies (TP=1/2/4, PP=1/2/4) on at least two GPU classes (A100-40GB, H100-80GB)
Metrics captured: tokens/sec, p50/p95/p99 latency, per-GPU utilization, KV cache hit ratio, batch size distribution; all exported to Grafana via prometheus metrics
Regression detector raises an alert if p95 increases beyond a statistically significant threshold (EWMA-based control chart) with <3% false positive rate on historical baseline traces
Automated report includes suggested root causes (KV warmup, imbalanced stages, increased batching variability) with links to top-correlated metrics and the exact experiment parameters
Nightly scheduled job completes end-to-end and stores raw traces and aggregated metrics in our benchmark S3 bucket with a standardized artifact name schema
implementation_plan: Design load patterns and parameter space; create canonical traffic recipes (microburst, sawtooth, poisson, step) - @Ava (2d)
Extend loadgen binary to support stochastic inter-arrival, per-connection concurrency, and KV-cache warmup flags - @Marcus (5d)
Add telemetry hooks to runtime to emit per-step batch sizes and stage latency (if not already instrumented) - @Sofia Mirza (3d)
Build EWMA-based regression detector service that consumes Prometheus metrics and computes adaptive thresholds; wire to alerting channel - @Marcus (4d)
Create experiment matrix and provisioning scripts for mesh shapes + heterogeneous GPU nodes; add to runtimes/benchmarks infra - @Infra team (3d)
Create CI job and nightly pipeline; persist artifacts and auto-generate regression report - @Ava + @Infra (3d)
Run cross-check experiments against historical incident traces to calibrate detector and document false-positive rate - all (2d)
test_matrix: Models: Llama2-13B, Llama2-70B (8-bit quantized variants and float32 baseline)
Hardware: 4xA100-40GB mesh, 8xH100-80GB mesh, mixed mesh (2xA100 + 2xH100) to exercise heterogeneity
Mesh shapes: TP in {1,2,4}, PP in {1,2,4}, combined across experiments
Workload params: batch sizes {1,2,4,8,16}, seq len {64,128,512}, concurrency patterns {steady, poisson(lambda=var), microburst(amplitude,duration)}
KV cache states: cold-start, warmed-prefix (50% hit), steady-state (>=95% hit), and degenerate miss scenarios
Duration: short-run 10m (fast feedback), long-run 2h (stability + tail analysis)
instrumentation: Prometheus metrics: tokens_per_sec, request_count, latency_ms_p50/p95/p99, kv_cache_hit_ratio, gpu_utilization_per_device, batching_variance
Labels: model, mesh_shape, tp, pp, gpu_type, batch_size, seq_len, run_id
Traces: full per-request timestamps and stage-level latencies (serialized to S3 as newline-delimited JSON), include KV cache event markers
Dashboards: grafana panel for tokens/sec heatmap, p95 drift timeseries, per-stage imbalance line chart, EWMA control-chart overlay
Alerting: regression-detector -> #perf-alerts Slack + incident playbook link
updates: 2026-02-16: Kickoff meeting. Agreed canonical patterns and evaluation matrix. Decided to prioritize EWMA detector over fixed-thresholds to reduce false positives.
2026-02-20: Loadgen prototype supports poisson and microburst arrivals; initial scripts for KV-cache markers created. Local smoke tests show expected burst shapes.
2026-02-25: Instrumented per-stage latencies in runtime (PR #5123). Noted that PP stage 2 has 20% higher variance on mixed GPUs; added imbalance metric to telemetry.
2026-03-01: First nightly run against A100 4x; observed p95 bump during cold-start microburst in 3/10 runs. Calibrating EWMA half-life to reduce noise-triggered alerts.

2026-03-05: Review with PM and Reliability: agreed false-positive target <3% and detection latency <= 15 minutes for sustained regressions. Created follow-up ENG tasks for auto-rollbacks in canary flows.
2026-03-08: PWG benchmarking notes: H100 mesh shows different batching behavior due to kernel packing; added per-kernel stat export in runtime. Draft PR for detector (WIP) created.
2026-03-10: Baseline historical traces replayed; EWMA detector with alpha=0.1 yields ~1.8% FP on held-out data. Preparing to merge along with nightly CI job next week.
Review feedback: Design reviewer @Priya Kumar suggested adding a 'stable-window' concept to ignore first N minutes to avoid warmup noise. Implemented as run parameter 'ignore_initial_seconds'.
